criteria.question: does Johnston's organ drive reach the giant fiber through the declared JON -> GF pairs, leaving GF mostly subthreshold on its own, with no drive through a rewired chemical-only null and the CNS quiet?

protocol.trials_note: canonical trial count per arm for A1, A3, A4 and the reference arm (a run at fewer is flagged TRIALS by summarize)
protocol.jo_drive: the JO types MaleCNS annotates as auditory ('unclear' types excluded) at 150 Hz in 60 ms pulses, 300 ms gaps (flycns.bench.pulse_protocol)
protocol.readouts: GF spikes in 160 ms after onset; GF peak depolarisation above rest in 100 ms after onset
protocol.seeds: the declared default seed (LIFParams().seed) = BASE for A1, A3, A4 and the reference arm; A2 calibration arms BASE + 1000 + gain index; A2 loom alone BASE, loom + sound BASE + 1
protocol.a2_working_point: calibrated per run over loom gains [0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.3]: the largest with GF hit <= 0.3 and mean depolarisation >= 2 mV (A2 is reported here, scored by a2_registered)

A1_jo_alone_mostly_subthreshold.rule: PASS if the Wilson 95% interval of the fraction of A1 trials (JO drive alone, electrical) with any GF spike lies at or below 0.3

A3_declared_pairs_carry_jo_drive.rule: PASS if both parts pass: the bootstrap 95% interval of A1 GF peak depolarisation lies above 0.5 mV (exclusive), and the interval of (A3 depolarisation - 0.5 x A1 depolarisation), arms resampled independently, lies at or below 0

A4_null_silent.rule: PASS if both parts pass: the Wilson 95% interval of the fraction of rewired-null trials with any GF spike lies at or below 0.1, and the bootstrap interval of null GF peak depolarisation at or below 0.5 mV

A5_cns_quiet.rule: PASS if the larger of the A1 and A2 whole-run population rates is below 0.05 Hz per neuron (readouts with no trial structure, scored on the point value)

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 10 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020

supersedes.why: model refrozen: the JON -> GF compound potential is calibrated per giant fiber on its own coupled afferents (run 12 measured 3.65 and 0.73 mV for a 3 mV target); w_scale 0.3 -> 0.4, the value the registered benchmark-blind rule selects (fit/select_wscale.py); the giant fiber adaptation refit under both (benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py). Criteria unchanged.
